string_step_plans.law:
Batch 1 step plans (Pantera LP1/RP2-only strings, 2026-10-24). Engine: fighter.js _attackClipPlan step-plan branch. A step plays its row ONLY when status is verified (button bitmask + stance + throw gates pass). review/unmapped steps play NO bank row - never a donor/generic row - and are flagged in _atkPlan.unmapped. T3 rows here are FALLBACK (see docs/anim/PROCEDURAL_AUDIT.md Batch-1 entry): T7 King clip bytes for 0x8000 moves are unresolved, so T3 step rows stand in until T7 extraction lands, then re-match. Rows 35/220 are NEVER verified for standing-context steps. Full gate evidence (hit_frames + FK peaks) in docs/movesets/BATCH1-STEP-PLANS-2026-10-24.md.

Batch 2 step plans (Pantera LK3/RK4-only strings, 2026-10-25). Same engine branch, same gates as Batch 1, plus: SOFT limb-peak gate uses the Job 1 peakF proxy (window = stream active window / 2, +/-2 frames), validated 13/13 on Batch 1 verified steps; the proxy is conservative (a max peak outside the window can hide a secondary peak inside, so proxy-fail means review, never a false verify); SOFT gate waived for jumping-context strings as in Batch 1. Stance gate: jump/starts-airborne rows fail ground-context steps and pass jump-context steps; crouch rows pass only crouch-context steps; ground rows fail all; ws-context steps matched to standing rows are review (ws->standing soft-stance). Job 3 fills wired ONLY on exact level + FULL provenance + step HARD gates (Batch 2 has none: all 11 Batch 2 Job 3 targets have empty pass-all lists); SOFT and ROW-ONLY candidates are documented, never wired. Job 4 joins never promote a step. T3 rows here are FALLBACK (see docs/anim/PROCEDURAL_AUDIT.md Batch-2 entry). Full gate evidence in docs/movesets/BATCH2-STEP-PLANS-2026-10-25.md.

Batch 3 step plans (Pantera mixed-pair strings, 2026-10-25). Same engine branch, same gates as Batches 1-2, plus: step limbs generalised (LP1=armL, RP2=armR, LK3=legL, RK4=legR; chord steps carry both limbs, SOFT proxy passes on at least one limb peak in window); SOFT gate waived for jumping-context strings as in Batch 1 (all 6 jump canonicals verify with the waiver noted in their reasons). Grapple-label rule refined: only the Batch 1 known grapple-chain set {PILE_DRIVER, ARM_BREAKER, TACKLE} counts as a grapple label — JGS (Jaguar Step, a stance) in JGS.3,2+3 is planned, not CSV-only; Batch 2 had no labeled strings so no Batch 2 result changes. Job 3 fills wired ONLY on exact level + FULL provenance + step HARD gates (Batch 3 has none: 9 pantera Job 3 targets, 8 with empty pass-all lists, 1 (u/b+1) with 4 SOFT-filed FULL candidates documented, never wired — no SOFT fill is inherited from #1097, whose row-49 fill is still unapproved). Job 4 joins never promote a step (6 joins, all rejected). T3 rows here are FALLBACK (see docs/anim/PROCEDURAL_AUDIT.md Batch-3 entry). Full gate evidence in docs/movesets/BATCH3-STEP-PLANS-2026-10-25.md.

Batch 4 step plans (Pantera triples/quads/rest strings, 2026-10-25). Same engine branch, same gates as Batches 1-3. Universe = every canonical comma key NOT covered by Batches 1-3: triples/quads (all-button union of 3-4 distinct buttons, 95 canonicals) plus the rest (63 canonical movement/stance sequences whose steps include a buttonless direction/stance token — CSV-audited only, never planned: their non-attack steps have no attack row, and planning them would need engine support for non-attack prefix steps, future work, not guessed here). Planned = triple-quad strike strings only (65 canonicals, 72 plan keys with twins); throw/grapple-class and grapple-label (PILE_DRIVER/ARM_BREAKER/TACKLE) canonicals are CSV-audited, never planned (Batches 1/3 precedent). Other throw-named chains with move_class string (BACKDROP, POWER_BOMB, etc.) are planned under that narrow label rule but their steps fail the strike HARD gates (throw flag) and land unmapped — never wired as strikes. Job 3 fills wired ONLY on exact level + FULL provenance + step HARD gates (Batch 4 has none: 10 Job 3 targets, incl. the u/b+1 4-way SOFT tie and a rest-key exact+FULL row 143, all documented, never wired — no SOFT fill is inherited from #1097, whose row-49 fill is still unapproved). Job 4 joins never promote a step (46 joins, all rejected or no-action on already-verified steps). Most unmapped planned steps have NO candidate at all: their intermediate prefixes are T8-sourced with no T3 row, so the correct clips come from #988 Step 2 (original T8 refs) or future extraction, never from a T3 row recorded as correct. T3 rows here are FALLBACK (see docs/anim/PROCEDURAL_AUDIT.md Batch-4 entry). Full gate evidence in docs/movesets/BATCH4-STEP-PLANS-2026-10-25.md.

string_fix_20261024.rule: WH fires each string STEP as its own attack, so a step move's runtime damage = T7 MOD damage of that step's hit (last hit of the MOD row), not the running total. Singles that fire via slots use MOD damage. T8 multi_hit.total values are left untouched as source records.

not_changed_on_purpose.1+2: WH SIGNATURE (Battle Itself) — canon move, not King's T7 1+2; MOD 24 not applied.
not_changed_on_purpose.plain T3 records (1, 2, 2,1, WS.2,2 shad: shadowed by slots; left as T3 source records.
not_changed_on_purpose.f,f,2 / f,f,1+2 held spellings: NOT added: indistinguishable from f,F+2 / f,F+1+2 in the resolver (same [f,f] dirs; held-final-direction rule picks the capital spelling). Playable forms f,f,n,2 and f,f,n,1+2 already fire.
not_changed_on_purpose.close/far proximity variants: not expressible (no proximity system): d/f+3+4 (Close), f,F+2+3 (Close), 3+4,3,2+3 (Close), f,F+1+2 (Far).
not_changed_on_purpose.spin scaling: JGS follow-ups set to 1-spin MOD values; WH has no spin counter, so 2–5-spin damage scaling is UNMAPPED.
not_changed_on_purpose.ALI.2 / ALI.1: T7 ALI row is ambiguous (18,13); left untouched, flagged UNMAPPED.
not_changed_on_purpose.d/f+4,3,4,B: direction ending, not a hit — hits already covered by d/f+4,3,4.

string_fix_20261024.animations: No string step maps to T3 row 35 (LP1+RP2 chord) or any chord row in this file (checked: t3_row is None for all T7-wired steps; animation comes from fighter.js match/donor fallback and is UNVERIFIED per move — see research doc).
string_fix_20261024.runtime_notation: Runtime keys stay 1/2/3/4 (fighter.js + movesets.js resolve on exact 1/2/3/4 strings; renaming keys to LP1/RP2 would break every lookup). input_lp is display only.

canon_wiring.note: Additive canon wiring for the Move List Creator. canon_moves entries are NEW entries; no Tekken moves entry was replaced or overwritten. Existing entries gained only an anim_ref field where one was missing. wh: refs are placeholders for animations not yet authored (see canon file header); made: refs are wiring labels pending the sibling animation lane clips. NOT play-verified.

t7_motbin.method: Additive wiring: this section is NEW. No existing moveset entry was modified, reordered, or deleted. Existing playable moves keep their current anim_ref; motbin internal moves are NOT joined to playable input keys by name similarity, and no .mvl display walk was performed in this batch, so no existing anim_ref was overwritten on a guess. A future input-key join must be walk-verified from the cancel tables below.
t7_motbin.anim_ref_format: t7mot:<code>:0xXXXX where XXXX is the exact anim_ref from mot.bin; bank = anim_ref & 0xC000; clip_key = anim_ref - bank
t7_motbin.cancel_note: String continuations are ONLY these cancel rows from the file. move_id >= 0x8000 is an alias reference, not a move index, and must not be resolved silently. Runtime input keys stay 1/2/3/4; input_lp is display only (1=LP1, 2=RP2, 3=LK3, 4=RK4).
t7_motbin.damage_note: damage here is the motbin hit_condition damage for the move; it is NOT MOD damage and does NOT replace any existing t7.damage in this file.
t7_motbin.clip_blocker: 0x8000-bank clip bytes: the 0x8000 MOTA block is not present in tkdata repo files; clip bytes live only in pakchunk archives / live-game memory, which this Linux VM without GPU cannot run. Those moves carry clip_status BLOCKER_MAIN_MOTA_NOT_IN_TKDATA; their key is recorded, bytes were not guessed. 0x0000/0x4000 rows carry SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_BYTES_UNRESOLVED: source identified by bank, byte offsets not resolved in this batch.
t7_motbin.editor_note: Loader/editor consumption of this section (Move List Creator) is a follow-up for the game-code lane; this PR wires the data into the file at the correct integration point without rewriting game code.

chord_string_enders.status: UNMAPPED — left unwired. A string needs a verified sequence clip and no such row exists in-bank. No string ender was rewired to a single-hit row.

t3_verification_2026_10_24.legacy_strings_arrays_note: Legacy `strings` arrays are NOT consumed by fighter.js; single-button hits on chord rows in them (2,1 hit LP1 -> row 220) are left unchanged — do not 'fix' them by guessing a single row.
t3_verification_2026_10_24.runtime_effect_of_unmapped_marking: Marked entries carry no exact anim_ref/t3_row claim, so the runtime falls to donor/match/generic for those presses and the editor shows them as unmapped (not offered as swap targets) until a verified exact row lands. The former row is kept in t3_unmapped_former_row for audit trail only.

named_systems.note: Western Heart renamed-system entries for Pantera. Correct animations come ONLY from the original Tekken system's clips (user directive 2026-10-24 22:09 CDT). Anything not yet extracted is UNMAPPED here, never a T3 clip or class-match presented as the mapping. A T3 clip may serve as a temporary in-game fallback; where one exists it is labelled temporary fallback, never the mapping. Buttons: LP1 = Left Punch = Tekken 1, RP2 = Right Punch = Tekken 2, LK3 = Left Kick = Tekken 3, RK4 = Right Kick = Tekken 4. Amatsu Rinne is EXCLUDED (future design, no work). Rinne damage boost is an OPEN user question, NOT wired.

rinne.gating: Low HP at or below 25% of max HP, once per round (fighter.js _inputCtx rage flag; _rageUsed set when an R./RD. move fires). Resolver offers the R. prefix only while gating holds (movesets.js _pressV2).
rinne.presentation: PARTIAL - aura method exists (fighter.js setRageAura) with no caller found in fighter.js; small HUD tag + gauge + aura per spec are NOT verified wired in this change. No banner, per spec.
rinne.damage_boost: OPEN QUESTION FOR THE USER - not wired, not assumed. No Rage/Rinne damage multiplier was found in fighter.js or combat-core.js on main at read time.
rinne.correct_anim: UNMAPPED - Tekken Rage state presentation rendered in WH canon look; no clip mapping claimed.

ikari_jishin.correct_anim: UNMAPPED - T7 King Rage Art clip for king_184 (live-memory extraction, anim_ref minus 0x8000 join; see extraction-100 package 01-t7-live). No playable clip exists in the repo today.

spin_juggle.engine_on_main: Screw/Tornado mechanic is ON MAIN via merged PR #1060 (game/js/combat-core.js, game/js/fighter.js): Screw spins the airborne opponent into a slump (SCREW_SLUMP_STUN 0.9s), Tornado flips into a ground bound (TORNADO_BOUND_STUN 0.8s), one extender slot per combo. The mechanic exists; Pantera has no flagged extender moves feeding it yet.
